node.title: E22 minimal-scale tail criterion
node.statement: For dyadic E22 support-scale data, a modulus M is the selected minimal admissible scale exactly when |B_M(R)|<M and every smaller admissible dyadic modulus M'<M has |B_{M'}(R)|>=M'. [TERMINOLOGY CORRECTION, catch #46: 'admissible' here means ELIGIBLE (M' > t) — self-contradictory with the branch's own admissibility definition as worded; one-word fix pending upstream re-pose.]
node.attack_surface: finite-chain reformulation of the canonical full-fiber/tail recovery rule
node.falsifier: a support whose selected minimal scale disagrees with the tail-size criterion
